description: Na₄Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.54 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.50 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.33 Å) and two longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.96 Å) and two longer (2.03 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Co is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing CoO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.21 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and two equivalent Co atoms.
